race.description: Sky Racing (N/P) Heat 1 Tg 1-4w Series F Pr2 Divis
race.comment: TOUGH COOKIE (1) wasn't far away at the finish when 4th and beaten only 3.5 lengths (20.56) at this track. Solid record here at the distance winning three races. Rates on top in this line up. ALL IN ANGUS (2) has mixed form recently, finishing fourth (20.74) in a TG1-4W at this track latest but did run well two back when in the frame. Can find the frame this time. ROCK ON BUB (7) missed the frame last time but had been racing well prior to that, winning a TG1-4W three back before a placing at this track the following run. Expecting sharp improvement. PANTS (8) comes into calculations after placing at this track and distance most recently.
